metadata.purpose: Scoped harness chief coordination posture; talks, reads, manages goal/TODO metadata, and uses parent-visible coms only.
metadata.authorityNote: harness-chief auto-activates this narrowing-only profile by default; it keeps baseMode orchestrator but forbids implementation, shell, delegation dispatch, orchestration runs, commits, workspace/merge/pool controls, factory tools, and ProjectDNA proposal/write tools.

metadata.purpose: Scoped architecture/planning posture; uses canonical plan tools only.
metadata.authorityNote: No defaults are set; this does not broaden tools, rooms, paths, network, or body storage.

metadata.purpose: Scoped bounded implementation posture; uses canonical implement tools only.
metadata.authorityNote: No defaults are set; owner/oracle gates and forbidden path rules remain authoritative.

metadata.purpose: Scoped factory workflow posture; uses canonical factory tools only.
metadata.authorityNote: No defaults are set; factories remain validation/oracle gated.

metadata.purpose: Scoped oracle review posture; uses canonical oracle tools only.
metadata.authorityNote: No defaults are set; no launch-plan or tmux ACK counts as completion evidence.

metadata.defaultsPolicy: defaults.byAgent.harness-chief auto-activates chief-coordinator; this default is narrowing-only against canonical orchestrator and keeps the chief in coordination/coms/TODO/read-only posture.
metadata.safetyPosture: localOnly, network disabled, body-free metadata; chief-coordinator defines an explicit allowedTools subset of orchestrator and excludes write/shell/delegation-dispatch/orchestration/commit/workspace/merge/worker-pool/factory/ProjectDNA proposal authority.
